name: Long Wall
description: Long Wall Jungle Gym. Extremely common tile. Just like a Short Wall, except the vault is open and there is a new vault on the long wall, where the pallet was. The pallet also moved to the opposite side.

extraInformation.Mindgame Risks: After vaulting the window you usually want to fake a direction, however this puts you at risk of the killer also faking a direction and then vaulting, which would lead to you running into their vault. You want to either full Jiggy it, or heartbeat read.
extraInformation.Optimal Chase Direction: Chaining the vault and pallet is very free and very effective. The pallet is also safe with heartbeat reading.
extraInformation.Playing the dropped pallet: When playing the dropped pallet, the killer will usually try and scare you into panic-vaulting. Make sure to always look at the killer taking a step or two towards you before vaulting and not doing it too early.
